sourceFile: 10. BRS-161014  Report check PROBLEM SUB 2 CMCP 2023.11.18_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source rows but the changed-factor grouping and extracted outcome values are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor improperly combines unrelated countermeasure trials and an artifact value.
Baseline/test conditions are not coherent across date, machine, material, lot, and process changes.
Outcome values for dry-oven comparison have incorrect NG counts.
Flat copper result is paired to dry-oven baseline without evidence of comparability.
Some cited rows are not shown in context, limiting citation auditability.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the sequential trials be one report with multiple factors or separate review cases?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factors from the Type rows, preserving date, machine, lot, material, and process conditions.
Separate dry-oven before/after machine #1 from material, cleaning, lot, pressure, and machine comparisons.
Correct Input, OK, NG, and NG-rate values from each cited result row.
Remove unsupported subgroup key and artifact condition labels.
Include only evidence rows directly supporting each factor and outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient until regrouped and value-checked.
